data.body: Phase 2 repair evidence. RED: the final held-out real-subprocess regression created four pre-existing numbered temp trees and a sentinel in another run's tree; before the fix, nested pytest deleted the sentinel and failed with 'nested pytest deleted another run's temp tree'. The fixer never saw this oracle. Fix: tests/_store_isolation.py now passes a caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest via --basetemp, isolating pytest session-finish cleanup without changing node selection, environment, timeout, capture, or ambient-store assertions. GREEN: the final two-test file passed; the exact omitted-basetemp mutation returned the sentinel test to RED; restoring the fix returned it to GREEN in 1.37s. Replication: 25/25 real nested-pytest outer-file runs passed (50 tests total), each about 2.2-2.7s, with no post-summary timeout. Safety: caller sweep found only the current unit and held-out tests; no behavioral dependency on shared temp cleanup, no production code or dependency change, and no existing assertion was weakened. Refactoring litmus passes because the oracle asserts observable filesystem survival, not private implementation structure. Sibling sweep: the independent nested collector tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::_collect_node_ids has the same omitted-basetemp construct and is outside this helper path; filed and linked acidic-ferreous-mole with exact file impact and RED/GREEN plan. CLI/MCP/library/automated/dual-direction parity surfaces are N/A because this is a test-harness subprocess helper. Gates: focused held-out GREEN; mutation RED then restored GREEN; 25-run replication GREEN; make lint GREEN; make typecheck GREEN; make test GREEN with 13,584 passed, 17 skipped, 288 deselected, 20 warnings in 2,958.87s. Residual risk disposition: sibling filed as acidic-ferreous-mole; none otherwise. Session log: kilted-centauric-cardinal.
